local_notes: A Banjarbaru parent testimonial ('Bunda Umar') appears on the official page. Directmap shows a 5★ rating. Birru's Jayapura branch reviews call it 'Al-Birru / Rumah Terapi Albiru', so Birru Care is the renamed Al-Birru brand. The batch-2 'Rumah Terapi Al-Birru' pin in Sungai Sipai, Martapura (IG rumahterapialbirru_banjarbaru, reviews 2021–2022) is probably an earlier Al-Birru location, but no source ties it to the Karang Anyar address, so I did not use its coordinates.
